Thanks Elena — good summary. Quick answers and proposed plan: 

1) DocuSign: preferred for the Order Form (fastest for countersignature). We can also provide a PDF if you need it attached to your Ariba record.
2) PO format: our finance team issues POs with prefix RW- (example RW-2026-45321). Payment terms vary by customer, but for procurements of this class we typically accept Net 30. If ProcureNet requires Net 10 we can escalate.
3) Ariba: we support Ariba registration and can complete punchout. If you provide the Ariba vendor ID we can map it to our internal vendor code.

Action items from Redwood:
- Marissa: please review the attached OrderForm_Draft_v3.xlsx and confirm billing contact and final quantities.
- Karthik (Legal): we'll route the MSA redlines to legal — attaching the version of our MSA that the commercial team prefers.

I'll send a single bundle to you once we have the redlined MSA and the Order Form with signatories. Aim to get this to you by EOD tomorrow.
